title: Claude in Paris
notes: Draft beat sheet for Gate 1. Positions are placeholders in world units until the Paris diorama blockout exists; the timing they produce is already real, which is the point of running the plan before anything is modelled.

beats.name: arrival
beats.content: Claude steps into frame, back to camera, looking up. Establishes scale and the city's warm morning light.
beats.narration: I have read about this place ten thousand times.

beats.name: the-street
beats.content: Camera drifts along a cafe terrace. Claude turns, delighted, as the street reveals itself.
beats.narration: Nobody told me it would smell like bread.

beats.name: the-river
beats.content: The move lifts over the river. Light on water carries the frame while Claude leans on the railing.
beats.narration: Or that the light would move like that.

beats.name: the-reveal
beats.content: Camera rises; the tower enters frame late and from below. The payoff shot.
beats.narration: I knew exactly how tall it was.

beats.name: the-feeling
beats.content: Push in on Claude, small against the city, entirely happy. Music resolves on the final frame.
beats.narration: Knowing is not the same as standing here.
